_comment: Per-host client-side limits for KEYLESS public RPC endpoints (scripts/lib/rpcLimiter.js). Only hosts listed here are throttled; Alchemy, Helius and any keyed endpoint are never touched. rps = steady requests/second shared by every caller in the process, burst = token-bucket size, concurrency = max in-flight requests, maxGetLogsResults = the provider's result cap (used to size eth_getLogs ranges), minSplitBlocks = smallest eth_getLogs range we will bisect to. Override any host with RPC_LIMITS_JSON='{"host":{...}}'.

gateway.tenderly.co._source: measured 2026-11-04 (scripts/probe-log-ranges.js): 'invalid params' + data 'Query returned more than 20000 results. Try with this block range [..]'; no block-range cap on mainnet/polygon

base.gateway.tenderly.co._source: measured 2026-11-04: 'Block range too large: maximum 1000 blocks without an access key'

rpc.mevblocker.io._source: measured 2026-11-04: 'Log response size exceeded ... up to a 10,000 block range ... or 10,000 logs'; Cloudflare HTML 429 with Retry-After: 0 under load (treated as min backoff)

base.rpc.blxrbdn.com._source: measured 2026-11-04: wide ranges accepted but slow (50k blocks ~17s)

api.mainnet-beta.solana.com._source: published (solana.com/docs/references/clusters): 100 req/10s per IP, 40 req/10s per IP per method, 40 concurrent connections; getTransaction-heavy scans run 4-wide

_alchemy: Alchemy is keyed, not listed here: Free plan caps eth_getLogs at 10 blocks on every chain (60 CU/call); rpc.js learns the stated cap per key URL from the rejection.
